text:
noah: FYI opened PR #8012 — sdk migration guide (python + node). I accidentally left an example `redwood_config` with a UUID-like service account id (looks real). Need quick scrub and formal legal/sec sign-off before we promote.
tara: Can you paste the snippet here? I can scrub in a follow-up commit if necessary.
noah: snippet: ```yaml
redwood_config:
  service_account: 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000
  api_key: sk-live-abc123
```
sam: yep that's definitely a live-looking pattern. Policy: no live API keys or account IDs in public docs. Replace with placeholders like `<SERVICE_ACCOUNT_ID>` and `<API_KEY>` and add a note at top: "Do not paste production credentials."
legal: Please also remove any region/account combos in ARNs if present. If the example demonstrates HSM/KMS, use generic placeholders and avoid any CLI commands that show `--profile prod-account`.
sec: Echoing legal. Also run `tools/sensitive-check` locally; CI runs it too but it's better to catch early. For the SDK example, mark it non-executable or wrap with language `text` so docs-bot won't try to run examples in CI.
noah: thanks. I'll push a commit with placeholders and change the fenced block to ```text. Also will add the top-line guidance as requested.
ci-bot: preview failed for PR #8012: sensitive-detector found 1 match (api key pattern) in migration/python.md:64. Docs preview link: https://ci.internal/preview/8012/console
tara: After you push the scrub commit, please update the PR description with the commit hash and a short checklist of redaction steps so legal can track.
noah: done 178447702commit: scrubbed keys and ids, replaced with `<SERVICE_ACCOUNT_ID>` and `<API_KEY>`, changed code block to ```text, added top-line guidance. Updated PR description per request.
docs-bot: lint OK, linkcheck OK, exec-check: executable code blocks detected -> none after change.
ci-bot: re-run triggered. preview passed for PR #8012 178775012: artifacts: https://ci.internal/job/preview-8012/artifacts.zip
legal: Quick review done. Confirming placeholders in place and the required sentence added: "This document uses placeholders for credentials and sensitive identifiers. Do not paste production secrets into documentation." Approved for staging.
sec: Approved for security review. One suggestion: add an ops note in the Private deploy section advising the use of KMS aliases and environment variables rather than hardcoding. Not blocking.
tara: Great. Timeline check: can we merge to docs-staging now and run a canary tomorrow at 04:00 UTC?
legal: Fine to merge to staging since scrubbed and CI green. Final sign-off required before merging to main.
noah: merging to docs-staging now. I'll tag @legal and @sec on the staging PR so final sign-off is easy after canary.
docs-bot: merged PR #8012 to docs-staging by noah. Release note: "Canary: SDK migration guide (PR #8012) — sensitive content scrubbed; legal review pending final main merge."
noah: filing a follow-up infra ticket to add automated redaction checks into pre-commit hooks so future PRs catch this earlier. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
